dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 25, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tampa Bay Rays Blast Kansas City Royals 13-2, While Houston Astros Edge Detroit Tigers 2-1**

In a lopsided game, the Tampa Bay Rays' offense exploded for 13 runs, led by Junior Caminero's historic 3-home run, 6-RBI performance. Caminero's impressive day was part of a staff effort that saw the Rays' pitchers combine for a shutout through the final 7 innings. Ian Seymour earned the win with 6.2 scoreless innings, striking out 7. Across the league, Bryce Miller of the Pirates earned 11 strikeouts in 5.2 innings, while Tatsuya Imai of the Astros threw 6 shutout innings, striking out 10.
